issue.title: Cut artifact-link sweep cost for tiny document batches
issue.description:
## Feature proposal

Cut the artifact-link derivation sweep's cost on tiny document batches.

The 2026-11-27 10:33 apollo digest (plan
`plan:202611/artifact_link_job_budgets.md`) timed bob-cli sweeps at 90–195s
while scanning only 1–7 documents, against a 45s sweep budget. That leftover
time then starved reconcile. The job-budgets plan added a `sweep phases:
documents=… inputs=… derive=… persist=…` log line so the next pass can see
which phase dominates; it did not change the sweep implementation.

## Why this is out of scope

`plan:202611/artifact_link_job_budgets.md` only records per-phase timings and
skips the sweep on a reconcile-priority tick. Speeding up
`sweepable_artifact_link_documents`, derivation inputs, derive, or persist
for a handful of documents is the base-cost work that plan left as follow-up.

task_type_fields.proposal: Cut the artifact-link derivation sweep's cost on tiny batches (bob-cli: 90–195s while scanning 1–7 documents).
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: plan:202611/artifact_link_job_budgets.md only added sweep-phase timings and skip-sweep on priority ticks; speeding up the sweep itself is the base cost that plan left as follow-up.

issue.creation_reason: The approved job-budgets plan names 90–195s sweeps of 1–7 documents as an out-of-scope cost driver and only added phase timings. File this so the sweep-speed work is tracked separately from those logs.
